target_customer: Founders, early employees and investors with large liquid assets, plus their attorneys, financial advisors and accountants
problem: Setting up and administering trusts is slow, paperwork heavy and poorly served by traditional trust companies.
business_model: trust administration fees as a chartered trust company
product_category: AI-enabled trust company and trust administration

founders.name: Nimit Maru
prior_employers: Yahoo (senior software engineer, Maps and Travel)

competitors.name: Vanilla
competitors.what: Estate planning platform for advisors (founded 2019, Salt Lake City)

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow and document automation plus KYC; the hard part is regulatory, obtaining a trust charter and operating as a fiduciary.

defensibility.rationale: A Nevada chartered trust company is licensed by the Nevada Financial Institutions Division; competitors selling software do not hold a charter.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors sold planning software; no incumbent copied the chartered AI trust model by late 2026.

market_need_then: Growth of liquid wealth among founders and employees and demand for QSBS, SLAT and dynasty trusts; founders initially considered selling software to trust companies but chose to operate one.

identity.voice_and_tone: Warm and understated: 'You deserve a better trustee', 'Less chasing. More knowing.'

branding.brand_signature: Tagline: You deserve a better trustee
branding.community_and_virality: Launch film and newsletter; no external community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinct warm voice and tagline on own site, but other companies share the name Sava and no press on the brand itself.

pivots.why: Axios reports the founders initially considered selling software to trust companies before deciding to operate one.

outcome_analysis: Sava, a Fall 2025 YC company, chose to become a Nevada chartered trust company rather than sell software, creating a regulatory moat, and raised a $10M seed led by Gradient Ventures in October 2026. Serial founders with prior acquisitions helped; the company is live and active, with execution on charter operations still to prove.
notes: CB Insights lists an earlier seed of $500K dated 2025-11-26 with undisclosed investors; aggregator only, not recorded. Competitor sources are undated 2025 to 2026 comparisons. Valuation not disclosed. YC page lists NYC; some aggregators say San Francisco. Search found no source for the name origin.
